spatial_ground_truth_policy: Only public point/polygon records are accepted as spatial validation. Aggregate province statistics are context only and are never allocated to grid cells.

sources.name: Stimson Center — War Legacies Data Dashboard
sources.scope_note: Stimson describes the Quang Tri Clearance Data tab as showing clearance efforts in Dong Ha District and states the data are courtesy of QTMAC.

sources.name: Quang Tri Mine Action Center (QTMAC)
sources.scope_note: QTMAC states dashboard figures are updated from the IMSMA database managed by QTMAC/DBU.

note: The bundled release intentionally does not convert aggregate figures into grid labels. Run scripts/fetch_real_ground_truth.py on an Internet-connected machine to discover/download public ArcGIS geometry, then scripts/integrate_ground_truth.py.
